name: Y Raise
instructions: Lie chest-down on an incline bench holding light dumbbells.
Raise your arms overhead in a Y with thumbs up.
longevityNotes: Pressing strength keeps daily pushing — doors, shelves, getting up from the floor — easy and safe. Controlled pressing builds the shoulders, chest, and arms that protect you in a fall.
overview: A Y-shaped raise that strengthens the lower traps and rear delts.
